baseline.description: Re-pinned 2026-10-27 to green main commit e9d5d62 (Everruns 0.49, #874). The prior pin (66f4e9a, 2026-10-10) predated the coordination threads, connector and E2B tools, built-in rg search, web_search capability and Everruns 0.46 to 0.49 moves, which grew the first request by about 4.3k tokens (8.7k to 13.0k) on every sample, so the nightly failed on 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-27 on control token and cost drift with no correctness regression. Earlier history: the 2026-10-10, 2026-10-05 and 2026-09-19 re-pins and the #643 grep_files path_pattern fix (a real bug caught by this monitor, fixed in code with runtime::tests::grep_tool_matches_directory_anchored_nested_glob_path_pattern) are recorded in git history of this file. Re-pin periodically to keep the ordinary-control gates comparing against current architecture; the focused search-efficiency cases this baseline also anchors remain valid regardless of the pin date.
